AthleteIQ Ventures invests in early-stage companies building the future of human performance infrastructure and sports commerce. Through direct access to operators and performance environments, we help founders validate, refine, and accelerate category-defining products earlier than traditional investors.
 The Film Room is AthleteIQ Ventures' bi-monthly showcase for sports technology founders. Hosted by former NFL All-Pro and Pro Bowler, Adrian Phillips, each session brings up to five companies into a live business breakdown with athletes, operators, and venture investors who challenge the product, pressure test the market, and help founders understand what it takes to earn trust, adoption, and momentum in sports.
 Help us find the next generation of sports technology companies!
 AthleteIQ Ventures is building a national network of Scouts to help identify exceptional pre-seed and seed-stage companies at the intersection of sports, technology, and human performance.
 We're looking for highly connected, curious students and athletes who naturally hear about interesting companies, products, and technologies before they reach the broader market.
 What You'll Do 
 As an AthleteIQ Scout, you'll help us:
 • Identify promising pre-seed and seed-stage startups in sports technology, athlete performance, wellness, fan engagement, sports commerce, and related areas
• Introduce companies that you believe AthleteIQ should know about
• Stay connected to emerging founders, entrepreneurs, and innovators within your network
• Share insights on products and technologies you see gaining traction
• Help us identify the companies that could shape the future of sports and human performance
 You are not expected to conduct formal diligence or make investment decisions. Your job is simple: find interesting companies and help us get to know them early.
 What You'll Get 
 Being an AthleteIQ Scout gives you a front-row seat to the sports innovation ecosystem, including:
 • Access to The Film Room: See founders pitch alongside professional athletes and investors and get a behind-the-scenes look at how companies are evaluated
• Founder & Investor Network: Build relationships with entrepreneurs, investors, athletes, and sports industry leaders
• Early Access to Emerging Companies: Get exposure to startups before they become widely known
• Venture & Startup Experience: Learn how investors evaluate early-stage companies and what makes a compelling investment opportunity
• AthleteIQ Community: Become part of a growing network focused on the future of sports and human performance
 Who We're Looking For 
 You don't need to be an investor. We're looking for people who:
 • Have a strong network across sports, technology, entrepreneurship, or investing
• Are naturally curious about new products and companies
• Have a strong understanding of sports or the athlete experience
• Are plugged into what's happening on campus and beyond
• Enjoy making introductions and connecting people
• Want hands-on exposure to startups, venture capital, and sports innovation
 Student-athletes, graduate students, entrepreneurs, and students involved in business, technology, or entrepreneurship are all encouraged to apply.
 Interested?
 We're looking for exceptional people at leading universities across the country to join the first cohort of the AthleteIQ Scout Network.
 If you're interested in becoming an AthleteIQ Scout, complete this application.
